advisories.reason: Stack-exhaustion DoS when braces expands an attacker-supplied pattern. No patched braces exists (every version is in range), and npm's only 'fix' is downgrading eslint-config-next to 14.2 — two majors behind Next 16. braces runs only inside ESLint, on glob patterns written in our own lint config, on a developer machine or CI runner; it is never installed in the production image (--omit=dev) and never sees user input.
